group_scores.rationale: All five scheduled retailers reported in-window with beats/raises: Target comps +5.6% and FY guide raised to ~6% (T1 confirmed), Walmart cc sales +4.4% above guide top (T1 confirmed) with FY guide raised to 4.9-5.2% (CNBC), TJX comps +4% vs 2.9%, Lowe's comps outlook raised, Home Depot beat. Resilient holiday-season demand supports +1. Caveats: XLY is dominated by AMZN/TSLA, HD fell on housing, risk-off week (VIX 29). Confidence capped low (pillar unsaturated). [Cross-pillar synthesis W47: set to 0 as a duplicate event; see verifier_changes.]
group_scores.falsifier: Weak Black Friday/holiday sales data; diesel/transport costs squeezing retail margins; XLY dragged by AMZN/TSLA news unrelated to retail demand.

group_scores.rationale: CY2028 MA/Part D proposed rule (confirmed T1) tightens Star Ratings/QBP, adds mandatory ADVaNCE MA from 2029 and eases new-plan entry: mildly negative for MA-heavy insurers, but a proposal with no T2 market-reaction source and no dollar estimate. Federal Register and White House checks show no MFN or Section 232 pharma action in window. FDA approvals were small rare-disease drugs; Novartis raised forecasts. No IPAY 2028 prices published. Falling yields rule out rates as the cause of XLV's -3.26%.
group_scores.falsifier: T2 reporting of a material managed-care selloff or estimate cuts tied to the MA rule (-1); deep IPAY 2028 cuts on large drugs by 30 Nov; MFN or Section 232 pharma action.

group_scores.rationale: PJM filed large-load ride-through rules and a Fast Energization interconnection process on 16 Nov (verifier fetch of one PJM page returned empty, so unconfirmed) and approved transmission changes 18 Nov: incremental, mixed for IPPs (faster new supply) and modestly positive for transmission rate bases. NVIDIA's $115.8bn quarter and $130bn guide undercut AI-buildout slowdown fears; 10y fell 23bp to 4.92% and TIPS fell. Yet XLU lagged the world by ~3.6%, so evidence is mixed; default 0.
group_scores.falsifier: Confirmed hyperscaler capex cuts or adverse FERC/PJM rulings (-1); yields below 4.9% with new data-centre PPAs or favourable rulings (+1).

group_scores.rationale: Treasury data rule out a rate cause for SCHD's -3.29% week: in-window nominal and real yields fell and October CPI was released before the window. No dividend-specific catalyst, flow data or tax change found; the lag looks like positioning/de-grossing in a risk-off week (CNBC opinion describes a tech-to-defensive rotation, which contradicts the price action and cannot carry a score). Structural 30% US dividend withholding is not a weekly signal.
group_scores.falsifier: T2 evidence of heavy dividend-ETF redemptions or a continuing low-vol unwind (-1); sustained rates rally with rotation into value/dividend names (+1).
